prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single transparent 2D Slay the Spire 2 relic inventory icon, the starter relic "绿色宝石" for Junna Hoshimi of Revue Starlight.
The two supplied anime screenshots are visual REFERENCES for the actual bow-tip gem and gold mounting, not images to crop or reproduce as a scene.
Primary request: redraw the isolated emerald-green faceted jewel WITH ITS DISTINCTIVE GOLD BOW-TIP LEAF MOUNT. The recognizable object from the screenshots is a broad upright oval / rounded polygon gemstone, almost spherical with a shallow convex front, cut into large triangular facets. Gold swept pointed leaf-shaped fingers grow from one short curved bow-tip base, cradle the bottom and climb asymmetrically up its lower left and right sides; right gold finger taller, exposed gem face remains dominant. Keep this a detached bow finial, not a pendant or ring. Show only a compact short gold base beneath it, no long bow shaft. Give a slight diagonal lean to the upper left, three-quarter depth, gem face clearly visible.
Style: polished hand-painted fantasy roguelike inventory art, chunky dark green/brown outer silhouette, clean decisive big facets, restrained painterly shading, crisp cut edges, subtle imperfect brush character, no microtexture. Dense saturated forest/emerald green body, mint green facet highlights on upper left, deepest bottle green at lower edge; warm ochre and pale gold metal. A small glint within the stone, not glowing white overall. Gem should read green even at 32 pixels. 10-15 broad facets. Gold metal is a natural continuation of the bow's carved feather/leaf tip, with just 2-3 long carved lines, no elaborate filigree.
Composition: single centered object occupying about 82% of canvas height and 70% width, enough margin, square canvas, fully isolated on real transparent alpha. No cast shadow or backdrop.
Constraints: faithfully prioritize the anime reference leaf-shaped asymmetric mounting and broad green jewel. No circular jewelry bezel, no chain, no necklace eyelet, no extra crown, no detached stars, no frame, no text, no person, no entire bow, no fire. Output only one production icon.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: the upgraded Slay the Spire 2 starter relic icon "燃烧宝石" (Burning Gem) for Junna.
Edit target: the supplied transparent green gem icon. Create its visibly empowered version.
Lock the entire physical object: SAME shape, SAME position, SAME orientation, SAME dark outlines, SAME asymmetric gold leaf bow-tip mounting and SAME facet boundaries. Preserve the green mineral identity and all the existing gold shapes. Do not redesign the base or add jewelry.
Change ONLY its illumination and energy: ignite the center of the faceted emerald with a concentrated bright warm white/mint core, luminous mint-green light spreading along 4-5 existing large triangular facets, greener darker outer gem facets retained so it still reads emerald. Make this version clearly more intense than the starter. Put several sharp clean mint/cyan rays extending a short distance beyond the upper and left gem edges; use only 3-5 tapered bold rays, a restrained translucent emerald halo hugging the stone and a few tiny bright sparks. Warm pale lime light reflects across the existing gold leaf tips, but keep gold metal ochre shadows legible. This is luminous burning brilliance inside the jewel, based on Revue Starlight green sparkle, without literal orange fire. Keep the underlying 2D hand-painted game-icon style and broad clean high contrast shapes. The physical gem and mount must remain the exact same size and placement on the canvas; light may occupy the original transparent margins. No change to the object silhouette or facet geometry, no new ornament, no text, no frame, no background, no floor shadow. Real transparent alpha background, square canvas.
